coordinate_system.camera: recorded Habitat Rz@Ry@Rx mount, actual optical axis and pinhole intrinsics

splits: All four books fit only retained train trajectories; see each branch fit_trajectories.json. No eval/probe synthesized.

qc.keep: no hard error, no unresolved suspicious, rounded quality_score>=7

k256.fit: each retained nonleaking train trajectory equal total weight; real macro observation nodes, exact same indices as RVQ
k256.supervision: current retained image -> next retained image; true original terminal frame -> STOP
k256.micro_actions: merged; GT edges and all decoded motion codes must exceed10cm OR10deg; terminal preserved; K256_MICRO_VALIDATION.json
k256.deployment: execute one decoded macro goal then reobserve; recorded timestamp gaps are not control deadlines

rvq.fitting: from scratch on all frozen retained train trajectories; per-trajectory weight1; masked future padding; STOP excluded
rvq.target: five absolute local poses relative to current selected real observation, never chained increments
rvq.nodes: continuous selected real first-to-terminal image frames; timestamps preserved; omitted frames absent from current and history
rvq.heading_fit: 3deg ordinary; necessary fallback10deg and reverse excursion<=10deg
rvq.padding: repeat actual terminal pose; future_valid_mask marks real targets
rvq.decoded_minimum: each valid adjacent decoded step translation>0.05m OR yaw>5deg
rvq.unresolved: whole RVQ trajectory excluded, retained diagnostic only
rvq.stop: complete000 AND <apos_1299> iff original terminal; only complete000 decodes to zeros; any single zero code ordinary
rvq.deployment: execute decoded[0] once, then reobserve/update retained-node history/replan; recorded duration is not control duration

projection.object: real object-goal annotated AABB center, positive camera depth plus image bounds, vocabulary48x27; region goals have <opos_0> with no_object_target status
projection.pointing: corresponding true route at source height+3cm,5cm lattice,4m lookahead; furthest first contiguous in-frustum segment; existing special rotation tokens when no projectable route; terminal1299

reader.codec_storage: Annotation JSON uses integer lists; TrainingDataset.codec_ids is NumPy uint16. Reader action_token is a Python integer, not a model vocabulary ID.
reader.images: RGB uint8 HxWx3 arrays; list is history in chronological order followed by current selected observation
reader.tokenizer: map by token string with tokenizer.encode(...,add_special_tokens=False); require atomic registered tokens; source token IDs are not model IDs
reader.VeOmni: Generic explicit PyTorch Dataset supplied; no VeOmni installation or trainer integration claimed.

evaluation: Paired cohort only: complete trajectories successfully supervised in both branches. Both branches compared at identical true retained macro nodes. K256 rolls one decoded macro action per real retained node; RVQ rolls only decoded[0] per decision. Local H5 compares the same five actual future node frames; padding excluded. Metrics distributions are across per-trajectory metric values; no length weighting.
source_protection: Original OSS and prior products unmodified; independent source restore. No deletion; only the explicitly authorized static report, selected media and public statistics are published. Full training data is not uploaded.

video_storage.reference: source_video in every delivered training part is an absolute shared CPFS path
